title.value: Promoting and Optimizing the Use of 3D-Printed Objects in Spontaneous Recognition Memory Tasks in Rodents: A Method for Improving Rigor and Reproducibility
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated in the document and reflects the study's focus on 3D-printed objects in memory tasks for rodents.
title.quote: Promoting and Optimizing the Use of 3D-Printed Objects in Spontaneous Recognition Memory Tasks in Rodents: A Method for Improving Rigor and Reproducibility

analysis.description: The study discusses the benefits of using 3D-printed objects in spontaneous recognition memory tasks for rodents to improve rigor and reproducibility. It details strategies for designing and using these objects and provides a repository of tested designs.

type.justification: The paper provides empirical evidence and strategies on the use of 3D printing in memory tasks based on experimental observations and data.
type.quote: Here, we discuss the advantages of using 3D-printed objects in rodent spontaneous recognition memory tasks. We provide strategies for optimizing their design and usage.
